Description: The Exchange-Correlation functional. Can accept standard names or LibXC numerical codes.
The wavelet grid spacing in Bohr. Equivalent to plane-wave cutoff energy. Example: 0.35
Multipliers for the coarse and fine wavelet grid domains [crmult, frmult]. Expected as a list representation. Example: dft.rmult, 5.0, 8.0
Spin polarization. 1 for non-spin polarized, 2 for collinear spin-polarized.
The net charge of the system (e.g., 0.0 for neutral, 1.0 for cation, -1.0 for anion).
Maximum number of Self-Consistent Field (SCF) iterations.
The SCF convergence threshold based on the norm of the gradient. Example: 1e-4
The optimization algorithm for geometry relaxation. Skip or leave empty for single-point energy (SCF) calculations.
The maximum number of geometry optimization steps (number of force evaluations).
The threshold for forces on the atoms to stop the geometry relaxation (in Hartree/Bohr). Example: 0.001
